mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 2% signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 2% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls > 5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index exceeding 8% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls > 8% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and reduces corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 5% combined with a 3-month decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a synchronized weakening in both consumer and residential demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 5% AND HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both RSAFS falls > 5% AND HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
